intro: Rwanda is a presidential republic led by Paul Kagame since 2000.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years; Kagame won the 2024 election with over 99% of the vote. Parliament has over 60% women members.

chapters.title: Eastern Congo
text: Rwanda has been accused of supporting the M23 rebels in DR Congo; a peace deal was signed in 2025.
